scenarios.name: Energy anomaly
scenarios.question: Why did factory energy consumption increase near the end of the period?
scenarios.expected_signal: M03 energy and runtime rise disproportionately relative to production.
scenarios.expected_action: Inspect compressor operating schedule and air system; compare runtime to production.

scenarios.name: Machine inefficiency
scenarios.question: Why is M04 consuming more energy?
scenarios.expected_signal: M04 efficiency factor rises after overdue maintenance.
scenarios.expected_action: Perform overdue filter inspection/cleaning and verify energy consumption afterward.

scenarios.name: Historical knowledge
scenarios.question: Has the current M03 pattern happened before, and what worked?
scenarios.expected_signal: Historical M03 incident contains a similar high-energy symptom and verified intervention.
scenarios.expected_action: Retrieve prior verified M03 resolution and use it as evidence, not as an automatic conclusion.
